initialExam.title: PNB SO 2026 (Specialist Officer)
initialExam.description: Punjab National Bank Specialist Officer recruitment for specialized roles in IT, Law, HR, Finance, and other departments. PNB is India's second-largest public sector bank.
initialExam.qualifications: B.E/B.Tech/MBA/LLB/CA or relevant professional degree with experience
initialExam.syllabus: Professional Knowledge (domain-specific), Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, General Awareness.
initialExam.examPattern: Online Test: 200 questions, 200 marks, 2 hours. Interview: 50 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Online Test → Interview → Document Verification → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Specialist Officer in IT, Law, HR, Credit, Risk Management
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit pnbindia.in 2. Go to Careers 3. Register 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, NPS, Vehicle Loan, Housing Loan

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
